summary: Give suggestions seven theme colors that read well in dark mode

diagnostics.message: No exact registry source file found for suggestion-colors.

entries.summary: Add `--editor-suggestion-1` to `--editor-suggestion-7` to your theme, with a light and a dark value each, and the Tailwind colors `editor-suggestion-1` to `editor-suggestion-7`.
migrationNotes: To give suggestions your own colors, edit the `--editor-suggestion-*` values that shadcn wrote into `:root` and `.dark`. A later `shadcn add` keeps your edits.

entries.summary: Each suggestion paints its text, background, hover and active state from one of the seven `--editor-suggestion-*` colors, so suggestions read well in dark mode instead of showing light boxes. A change without a color of its own uses the first one.
migrationNotes: Components you copied before this change keep their old suggestion colors. Add `suggestion` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces any edits you made to that file.

entries.summary: A suggested board shape takes its suggestion's color instead of emerald.
migrationNotes: A `board` you copied before this change keeps emerald suggestions. Add `board` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces any edits you made to that file.

entries.summary: A suggested link, mention, date, equation or field shows the editor color instead of emerald until its suggestion's color applies.
migrationNotes: A `suggestion-style` you copied before this change keeps its emerald fallback. Add `suggestion-style` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces any edits you made to that file.

entries.summary: Keep a suggested field's chip, required marker, and role, skipped, and review labels at full contrast on the suggestion's background.
migrationNotes: A `field` you copied before this change dims its labels and paints the required marker in red when suggested. Add `field` again with `shadcn add --overwrite`, which replaces any edits you made to that file.
